text:
Ella: Heads-up — scheduled capacity bump for dedicated-eu-1 tonight 22:00 UTC. We'll increase pool size from 8 -> 12 and adjust autoscaler min/max from 4/16 -> 6/20. Who can own the rollout + smoke checks? Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-capacity

Jamal: I can do the deploy. ETA: I'll start the preflight at 21:45 UTC and kick the rollout at 22:00. Need the smoke checklist.

Ella: thanks Jamal. Quick smoke checklist:
- ensure queue drain before scale
- warm 2 instances with sample requests
- run smoke script against canary slice
- verify metrics in dashboards and no fallback triggers

Ella: smoke curl (use canary token):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model": "redwood-dedicated-eu-1-canary", "input": "smoke test"}'
```

SRE-Bot: deploy-trigger: scheduled_deploy by Jamal at 2026-03-15T21:50:00Z :rocket:

Kevin: Rollback plan?

Ella: rollback is documented — revert autoscaler config and scale down slices to previous size. Commands:
```
kubectl apply -f /manifests/autoscaler-prev.yaml
kubectl scale --replicas=8 deployment/dedicated-eu-1
```
Also will keep a snapshot of current manifests in /artifacts/dedicated-eu-1-prebump.tar.gz

Anya: I'll run the smoke suite and report latency/errors. Ping me when canary is live.

Maria: I'll watch dashboards (latency, throughput, error-rate) and keep #incidents on standby. If P50 > 200ms or error-rate > 1% I'll call rollback.

Jamal: starting preflight now. tagging oncall @Anya

Anya: acknowledged :eyes: I'll be listening.

Jamal: canary at 22:00 -> 10% traffic for 15m, then 50% for 10m if ok, then full. If any alert hits during canary we abort and rollback.

Ella: Perfect. Post-status updates here. :thumbsup:

Maria: noted, will DM if anything noisy shows. Good luck :rocket:

Jamal: preflight done, warming instances. will update at canary start.

SRE-Bot: deploy-status: canary_started at 2026-03-15T22:00:00Z

Jamal: canary live. running smoke scripts.

Anya: smoke pass. P50=115ms, error-rate=0.2%, no fallback. proceeding to 50% stage.

Jamal: expanding to 50%.

SRE-Bot: deploy-status: ramp_to_50% at 2026-03-15T22:16:00Z

Maria: dashboards green so far.

Ella: thanks team. I'll close the change after full ramp if no issues.

Jamal: full ramp complete at 22:30. marking as done.

SRE-Bot: deploy-status: complete at 2026-03-15T22:30:00Z

Ella: change closed. :white_check_mark:
